article.title: Rules for winding up and dissolution.
article.content: The Central Government may make rules for the provisions in relation to winding up and dissolution of limited liability partnerships.
article.html:
65Rules for winding up and dissolution.

Section 65 · Chapter XIII · page 25 of the Act

The Central Government may make rules for the provisions in relation to winding up and dissolution of limited liability partnerships.
